description: This file is a PHP source code for the 'Wish List' controller in an OpenCart e-commerce project. It manages viewing, adding, and removing products from a user's wishlist, with functions for rendering wishlist pages, handling AJAX requests for adding/removing items, and ensuring user authentication.

classes.name: WishList
classes.description: Controller class for managing user wishlists in the OpenCart application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the wishlist page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading necessary scripts and views, and handling user login validation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to display the wishlist, validating login status.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of wishlist products, including product images, prices, stock statuses, and links, and returns the rendered view.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to add a product to the wishlist, updating the session and database if logged in, and returns success/error in JSON.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to remove a product from the wishlist, updating session and database if the user is logged in, with success/error response.
